testcase.name: Scenario: Float a docked panel and dock it again: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-docking-system-source/features/application/docking-system/docking-system.feature:107:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Float a docked panel and dock it again ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And a dockable panel is docked beside the viewport ✔ When the user drags its title bar away from the dock targets ✔ Then the panel floats above the workspace ✔ And the viewport expands into the space released by the panel ✔ When the user drags the floating panel to a workspace dock target ✔ Then the panel docks at that target ✔ And the viewport adjusts to the resulting workspace layout
